provenance: Ledger v7 sweep — 157 subclasses, four agents, fresh against the re-based damage par. Chassis ids resolved by naming.py.

cleric/Heavy armour / martial weapon tab.why: The heading is the domain-by-domain proficiency table used for dip planning, not a playable domain.

action-economy.why: Control Undead turns an enemy into the duo's missing third body; Action Surge adds a turn, but necrotic is widely resisted here.

skills.why: Magical Secrets at 6 buys Counterspell or Haste off-list; Lore's three proficiencies plus Expertise cover the campaign's gates.

cleric/Knowledge.uncertain: CCC's Magical Secrets pick count and source lists at Knowledge 6 and 10 are not stated on the mod page.

durability.why: Disciple of Life boosts every heal from any source, and Twinned Metamagic puts Death Ward or Greater Restoration on both bodies.

reaction.why: Improved Warding Flare imposes disadvantage on attacks against the partner, and Lone Wolf's spare reaction still pays for Riposte.

front-line.why: Domain Shillelagh makes a Wisdom melee body in heavy armour with no feat tax; Beast Master's companion is a cheap third body.
Heavy armour, martial weapons and Wrath of the Storm, with Destructive Wrath maximising thunder; Action Surge buys the swing Cleric lacks.

action-economy.why: Invoke Duplicity's decoy and Thief's second bonus action; the four-duplicate upgrade lands at 17, and the domain offers a duo little before then.

front-line.why: Extra Attack at 6 plus War Priest's bonus-action swing and Action Surge; Strength primary, so the domain's save DCs stay secondary.

reaction.why: The only Cleric with native Counterspell, and Lone Wolf's spare reaction pays for it; Spell Breaker buffs the partner's spell saves.

durability.why: Heavy armour plus Soul of the Forge's +1 AC and fire resistance; the Channel Divinity reaction bypasses physical resistance for either body.

reaction.why: Sentinel at Death's Door turns crits on either body into normal hits, and Path to the Grave doubles the partner's biggest swing.

action-economy.why: Every buff or heal on the partner buys them a free weapon attack, and Quickened fires that trigger from a bonus action.

durability.why: Emboldening Bond is a permanent d4 on both characters' attacks, checks and saves; light and medium armour only, so durability lags.

short-rest.why: Twilight Sanctuary temp-HPs both bodies every round and cleanses charm and fright, for one Channel Divinity charge a short rest refunds.

action-economy.why: The only Cleric domain with Haste on its own list, and Sorcerer 3's Twinned Spell puts it on both bodies.

front-line.why: Heavy armour, martial weapons and a bonus-action attack from level 1 with Action Surge; no Extra Attack outside War caps the ceiling.

short-rest.why: Consuming Fervor maximises the domain's Fireball on a short-rest Channel Divinity, and Quickened lets the second Action carry another spell.

durability.why: Spell Shield hands the partner temp HP with spell resistance and advantage on spell saves; Witch Hunter's Strike punishes concentrating casters.

lockdown.why: Prophecy of Doom is the widest control here off one short-rest charge, and Heightened Spell keeps its Wisdom save from decaying.
Invocation of Night blinds everything failing a Constitution save for Cleric-level rounds, and Shadow Magic's see-through Darkness stacks with it.
Inception gives disadvantage on the first save against every Wisdom or Intelligence spell, which does not decay; Torpor taxes enemy action economy.

cleric/Dream.uncertain: The DTO page lists no bonus proficiencies for the domain, so light/medium armour and no martial weapons is assumed.

action-economy.why: Amethyst ancestry adds Charisma to every Magic Missile dart, force resists almost nothing, and Draconic Resilience fixes the d6 body.

reaction.why: Bend Luck spends Lone Wolf's spare reaction to swing any roll; the surge table is a liability when one body is half the party.

action-economy.why: Tempest maximises lightning on a short-rest charge and hands a no-armour Sorcerer heavy armour; Tempestuous Magic keeps the caster out of melee.

durability.why: Strength of the Grave refuses the first knockdown, and Twilight Sanctuary plus heavy armour turns the d6 chassis into a body that holds.

lockdown.why: Psionic Sorcery casts the control list off sorcery points with no components, and Hypnotic Stare and Towering Ego sharpen both ends.

durability.why: Cleric healing as Charisma Sorcerer spells, so Twinned Death Ward and Revivify cover both bodies; Life adds heavy armour and Disciple of Life.

front-line.why: Scholar's Armament moves weapon attacks to Charisma, pairing Favored Soul's Extra Attack at 6 with Quickened casting on one stat.

sorcerer/Wretched Soul.why: The mod ships no feature list: levels, progression and Vile Affliction's effect are all unverified, and Listo added the pack for testing only.

skills.why: Three free proficiencies on top of Bard's three, Expertise four times, and Magical Secrets at 6; Thief adds a second bonus action.

front-line.split: Bard 17 (College of Swords) / Paladin 3 (Oath of Devotion)
front-line.why: Extra Attack at 6 with Flourishes, and Paladin 3 converts full-caster Bard slots into smites; the burst runs dry in long fights.
The only College handing a Charisma caster shields and martial weapons, with Extra Attack at 6 and Action Surge behind it.

durability.why: Mantle of Inspiration is bonus-action temp HP for the partner, but the real feature, Unbreakable Majesty, arrives only at 14.

lockdown.why: Unsettling Words debuffs the save before you commit the spell, and Heightened Spell turns a coin-flip Hold into disadvantage that never decays.

front-line.split: Bard 17 (College of Dance) / Monk 3 (Way of the Friar)
front-line.why: Unarmed damage rides the Inspiration die and Monk 3 adds Martial Arts and Flurry, but nothing here grants Extra Attack.

bard/College of Dance.uncertain: Whether Bardic Unarmed Attack's die replaces the damage of Monk Flurry of Blows strikes is not stated by either mod.

reaction.why: Sorrowful Fate moves a save to Charisma without concentration, and Poetry in Misery and Tale of Hubris both fit Lone Wolf's two reactions.

lockdown.why: The only blaster College: Concussion denies reactions, and Destructive Wrath maximises every thunder and lightning cast on a short-rest charge.

bard/College of Stormcalling.uncertain: Whether Electrifying Aria requires concentration is not stated in the DTO documentation, which decides whether it stacks with a second control spell.

front-line.split: Blood Hunter 17 (Order of the Ghostslayer) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
front-line.why: Crimson Rite is at-will damage on no clock, Brand of Sundering doubles its dice at 11, and Rite of the Dawn resists necrotic.

durability.split: Blood Hunter 17 (Order of the Lycan) / Rogue 3 (Thief)
durability.why: Hybrid Transformation stacks physical resistance, +1 AC and Dex-scaling unarmed strikes; Bloodlust turning you on your partner is the duo's worst failure.

short-rest.split: Blood Hunter 17 (Order of the Mutant) / Ranger 3 (Gloom Stalker)
short-rest.why: Celerity and Potency are raw ability score on a short-rest clock with the cap removed; every resistance mutagen sells a vulnerability.

lockdown.split: Blood Hunter 17 (Order of the Profane Soul) / Fighter 3 (Eldritch Knight)
lockdown.why: Brand of the Sapping Scar at 11 is blanket disadvantage on saves, slot-free and short-rest, which is what makes one control spell land.

front-line.why: Three attacks plus d10 superiority dice on the short-rest clock; Thief and Rage add a bonus action and physical resistance.

action-economy.why: Two Action Surges at 17, and Commander's Strike plus Bardic Inspiration spend the surplus on the partner's turn instead.

front-line.why: Reckless Attack plus an 18-20 crit range and a free reroll every turn: unbounded at-will damage on no clock, Survivor underneath.
Full Wizard list on an Intelligence body; Action Surge resets War Magic so one turn carries two spells and four attacks.

short-rest.why: Banishing and Grasping arrows are slot-free single-target control on a short rest; Gloom Stalker and Assassin pay for the opening round.

action-economy.why: Inspiring Surge turns each of two Action Surges into a partner reaction-attack, and Rallying Cry heals them off Second Wind.

durability.why: Brutish Durability adds 1d6 to every save on top of four proficiencies; Brute Force and Survivor make it unconditional and resource-free.

reaction.why: Warding Maneuver is prevention aimed at the partner; Vigilant Defender multiplies reactions and Twilight Sanctuary temp-HPs both bodies each round.
Battle Ready makes Intelligence the only stat, and Protective Field spends psionic dice reducing damage on the partner from nine metres.

short-rest.why: Master of Runes at 15 fires every rune twice per short rest: Hill's physical resistance, Fire's restrain, Cloud's redirect off the partner.

front-line.why: Elegant Courtier buys a fifth save proficiency, and Fighting Spirit's advantage feeds Sneak Attack; Strength Before Death refuses the run's failure mode.
Steady Aim's short-rest flat bonus stacks on three attacks, Archery and Gloom Stalker; Snap Shot plus Action Surge is the opening burst.

action-economy.why: Unleash Incarnation adds a melee attack per Action taken, and the echo threatens a second zone; stop at 15 because Legion of One never ships.
The dragon is a third combatant on your initiative, and two Action Surges each hand partner and dragon a reaction attack.

fighter/Purple Dragon Knight (2024 UA).uncertain: Author warns the dragon's Osiris scripting likely needs a fresh playthrough and breaks pathfinding indoors; camp-supply cost also scales with camp population.

action-economy.why: Borrowed Time hands the partner a whole Action, Alacrity adds a third reaction, and Battle Smith makes Intelligence the single stat.

fighter/Chronoknight.uncertain: Borrowed Time and Action Surge are mutually exclusive per turn, so the two engines alternate; the subclass is flagged as added 'for testing'.

lockdown.why: Fey Presence is slot-free area charm-or-fear on a short rest; Quickened and Twinned spend the pact slots twice a turn.

warlock/The Archfey.uncertain: Expansion lists no 14th-level Archfey feature, so Warlock 14 may be an empty level here.

durability.split: Warlock 14 (The Fiend) / Paladin 6 (Oath of the Ancients)
durability.why: Aura of Protection is a blanket save booster over four proficiencies, and short-rest pact slots refuel Divine Smite twice a rest.

lockdown.why: Chains of Carceri at 15 is slot-free hard control on the short clock; Hypnotic Stare and Mortal Reminder shave saves further.

front-line.split: Warlock 12 (The Hexblade) / Paladin 6 (Oath of the Ancients) / Fighter 2 (none)
front-line.why: Hex Warrior puts Charisma on the weapon at level one; short-rest pact slots become smites, Aura covers both saves, Action Surge doubles the burst.

short-rest.why: Same stat, different clock: Agonizing Blast beams and Quickened Mystic Arcanum off pact slots, with Hexblade's Curse widening the crit range.
Bonus-action Healing Light plus Revivify on a short-rest slot, and Disciple of Life multiplies every heal the pair casts.

warlock/The Celestial.uncertain: Healing Light's pool refreshes only on a long rest, so it is a per-day budget rather than a per-fight one.

short-rest.why: Focused Eldritch Blast detonates Warp inside the same Action for roughly 1.6x par Force damage, costing no slot or concentration.

warlock/The Psyker.uncertain: Perils of the Warp's compounding max-HP drain reads as unplayable by round two on the stat block; one combat log decides whether durability is 1 or 0. Detonation level map may key off Warlock rather than character level.

front-line.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Open Hand) / Rogue 3 (Thief)
front-line.why: Diamond Soul proficiencies in all six saves at 14, and Thief's extra bonus action doubles Flurries carrying free Topple and Push.
Shadow Arts covers the scouting a duo lacks off the ki pool, and Assassin converts every stealth opener into guaranteed crits.

monk/Way of the Four Elements (vanilla).dupe_of: monk/Warrior of the Elements (PHB2024 rework of Four Elements)
monk/Way of the Four Elements (vanilla).why: Its best expression is the elemental Monk body, which Warrior of the Elements does strictly better; the class file says it is superseded in almost every respect.

front-line.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Ascendant Dragon) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
front-line.why: The only Way handing the partner a resistance aura; Breath replaces an attack for real area damage, Action Surge buys another pass.

monk/Way of the Ascendant Dragon.uncertain: Ascendant Aspect's Blindsight needs a mod absent from 10.2; Breath dice stay far under Act II area par.

reaction.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Astral Self) / Cleric 3 (Twilight)
reaction.why: Wisdom alone drives attack, damage, AC and DC; Deflect Energy spends both Lone Wolf reactions and Twilight Sanctuary temp-HPs the partner.

front-line.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Kensei) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
front-line.why: Puts the Monk on Listo's enormous weapon pool instead of its thin unarmed one; Agile Parry is near-permanent +2 AC.

durability.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Long Death) / Barbarian 3 (Zealot)
durability.why: Mastery of Death converts dying into one ki off a short-rest pool, and Rage plus Zealot stack two more refusals to fall.

short-rest.why: From 11 every Flurry strike is a free full heal, and Hand of Ultimate Mercy removes the duo's in-combat death mode.

short-rest.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Sun Soul) / Rogue 3 (Thief)
short-rest.why: The one ranged Monk; Thief's second bonus action buys extra Sun Bolt volleys, and ki funds Searing Sunburst on the short clock.

monk/Way of the Sun Soul.uncertain: Scales on Dexterity rather than Wisdom, so it fights the rest of a Listo Monk's stat plan and is locked to commonly-resisted radiant.

reaction.why: Elemental Strikes put push-pull on opportunity attacks, and Cavalier's Hold the Line makes enemies provoke them for moving at all.

monk/Warrior of the Elements (PHB2024 re.uncertain: The mod defers levels 6, 11 and 17 numbers to screenshots, so Elemental Burst, Stride and Epitome values are unverified.

durability.why: Friar's Bond and Twilight Sanctuary both temp-HP the partner every round with no action, over Cleric restoration and a free teleport to them.

monk/Way of the Friar.uncertain: Friar's Bond costs Concentration, which competes with every other concentration effect the body might want.

durability.why: Flash of Genius adds Intelligence to the partner's saves twice a round, and free Heal, Greater Restoration and six elixirs offset long-rest supply cost.
Heavy armour, shield, Enhanced Defense and Mirror Image, plus a Guardian reaction that yanks an attacker off the partner.

artificer/Armorer.uncertain: Armorer never gains Intelligence-to-attack, so the body stays multi-attribute in a way Battle Smith does not.

action-economy.why: Two resummonable cannons at 15 plus a Homunculus is a four-body party from two characters, with +1d8 on every spell.
Intelligence drives attack, damage and DC; the Steel Defender is a third body imposing disadvantage on attacks aimed at the partner.

durability.why: Arcane Ward recharges every short rest at 10 and Projected Ward spends the spare reaction absorbing damage aimed at the partner.

front-line.why: Bladesong's +4 AC and +4 Constitution saves plus Extra Attack and Intelligence-to-damage at 14 make the only durable full caster here.

action-economy.why: Focused Conjuration at 10 makes summons unbreakable by damage, and Twinned Haste from the Sorcerer dip hands the partner a whole Action.

reaction.why: Portent dice are reaction-spent guaranteed failures on enemy saves, refunded on short rests at 6, and Lone Wolf grants a second reaction.

wizard/Divination.uncertain: Expansion's Greater Portent at 14 is listed as uncertain in the class file; not counted here.

lockdown.why: Hypnotic Gaze strips concentration with no slot, Split Enchantment doubles Hold Person at 10, and Heightened Spell offsets Listo's climbing save DCs.
Sculpt Spells keeps the partner out of your own fireball, and Tempest's Destructive Wrath maximises lightning on a short-rest charge.

action-economy.why: Thinnest school here: bonus-action Minor Illusion and one guaranteed miss at 10; the Thief dip supplies the breadth the school lacks.
Animate Dead++ removes the undead cap and upcasts on 9th-level slots; Haste on the partner puts a fifth and sixth body up.

durability.why: Transmuter's Stone hands the partner Constitution save proficiency permanently; Artificer 2 buys medium armour, shields and +1 spell DC without costing a feat.

wizard/Transmutation.uncertain: Artificer's rounded-up spellcaster passive is documented as core-game-only; its interaction with Wizard slots was not verified.

reaction.why: A reaction-based AC and save spike on the spare Lone Wolf reaction, plus War Priest's bonus-action attack; actual numbers are unpublished.

wizard/War Magic.uncertain: Arcane Deflection, Tactical Wit, Power Surge and Durable Magic numbers are images-only on the mod page and unverified.

short-rest.why: Formulaic Attunement ignores resistance to your attuned damage type, which Absolute Wrath hands out freely, and pact slots refuel on short rests.

wizard/Order of Scribes.uncertain: Levels for Wizardly Quill and Awakened Spellbook, and the size of the Formulaic Attunement damage bonus, are unverified.

durability.why: Two invocations at 2 and four by 14, ritual temp HP on every cast, and charm-and-fear immunity at 10 on an Intelligence chassis.

lockdown.why: Erudite Remedy is bonus-action healing plus chosen elemental resistance on the partner; Warding Rejuvenation raises them downed and Disciple of Life inflates every die.
Inescapable Destruction ignores necrotic resistance at 6, Reaper doubles necromancy cantrips, and Touch of Death converts Arcane Recovery charges into damage.

wizard/School of Death.uncertain: Necrotic-only output still meets outright immunity, which Inescapable Destruction does not cover; no defensive layer from the school at all.

lockdown.why: A slot-free bomb every turn laying its own surface, and from 14 it rides a levelled spell on the bonus action.

wizard/School of Bombardment.uncertain: Salvo and Barrage require 2 and 3 Bombs but the pak grants only 1, so both look unreachable; whether a bomb itself refills the charge is unverified.

front-line.split: Paladin 14 (Oath of Devotion) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master) / Sorcerer 3 (Draconic Bloodline)
front-line.why: Sacred Weapon adds Charisma to attack rolls, Action Surge and Quickened stack smites into one turn, and the level 7 aura blanks charm.

durability.split: Paladin 14 (Oath of the Ancients) / Warlock 3 (The Hexblade) / Sorcerer 3 (Draconic Bloodline)
durability.why: Aura of Warding at 7 gives both characters resistance to spell damage, and Hexblade pact slots refuel smites on short rests.

front-line.split: Paladin 14 (Oath of Vengeance) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master) / Warlock 3 (The Hexblade)
front-line.why: Vow of Enmity is short-rest advantage spent across four attacks under Lone Wolf's second Action, with pact slots and manoeuvres feeding burst.

reaction.split: Paladin 17 (Oath of the Crown) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
reaction.why: Crown's taunt drags attacks onto the heavy-armour body, and Battle Master Riposte spends both Lone Wolf reactions punishing them.

front-line.why: Smite is entirely necrotic here, which is wrong for Act 2, and Aura of Hate buffs nothing unless the partner is undead.

paladin/Oathbreaker.uncertain: Aura of Hate's duo value depends entirely on the partner playing a Ghastly Ghouls undead race, which the seed cannot assume.

lockdown.why: Only monoclass reaches Invincible Conqueror: all-damage resistance, an extra attack and 19-20 crits; Conquering Presence is short-rest area Frighten.

paladin/Oath of Conquest.uncertain: The aura's speed-reduction clause does nothing in BG3, and Frightened is a Wisdom save that decays as enemy DCs climb.

front-line.split: Paladin 14 (Oath of the Bleak Walkers) / Fighter 3 (Champion) / Warlock 3 (The Hexblade)
front-line.why: The level 7 aura lowers both characters' crit threshold and stacks with Champion, and Black Flames adds burst on top of smites.

durability.why: Aura of Moonlight is flat Charisma-modifier reduction on every hit either character takes, and Divine Guardian halves the partner's damage on a short-rest charge.

paladin/Oath of the Moon (Selûne-inspire.uncertain: Whether Listo's global 9m/15m aura patch reaches this v10.0-era subclass is unverified; Warding Bond is deliberately not scored.

front-line.split: Paladin 14 (Oath of Illumination) / Warlock 3 (The Hexblade) / Sorcerer 3 (Draconic Bloodline)
front-line.why: Ranged radiant paladin, the right damage type for Act 2, but no level-by-level feature list is published anywhere.

paladin/Oath of Illumination.uncertain: Only Aura of Brilliance is recoverable by name; every level and number is unverified and Listo added the pack for testing.

paladin/Supporting library.why: A note about Oath Framework, a developer-facing API mod with no player-facing features and no selectable oath of its own.

short-rest.why: Natural Recovery is the only in-day slot refund in the class, which matters when a long rest costs 120 supplies.

durability.why: Wild Shape is a second health bar and the overhaul keeps multiclass features working inside it; Rage stacks physical resistance on top.

druid/Circle of the Moon.uncertain: That Rage remains usable and beneficial inside an overhauled Wild Shape form was not verified.

front-line.why: Symbiotic Entity is four temp HP per druid level plus damage; Zeal buys heavy armour and a Wisdom-scaled bonus-action attack.

druid/Circle of the Spores.uncertain: That the Extra Attack mod and the Wild Shape overhaul resolve to exactly one Extra Attack is flagged unverified in the class file.

short-rest.why: Cosmic Omens recharge on short rests here: three or four swings of a d6 on any save either character makes.

lockdown.why: Wrath of the Sea is a bonus-action Wisdom-scaled cold hit with forced movement, the cheapest way to peel something off the partner.

durability.why: Storm Shift is 51 temp HP until long rest for one charge, and at 10 your element ignores resistance entirely.

druid/Circle of Stormchasers.uncertain: Storm's Reach damage is locked at its level-12 value and stops scaling, so it is a flat feature that falls.

front-line.why: Winter Spirit is 85 temp HP plus Wisdom on every damage spell, and cold spells knock failures prone from 10.

durability.why: A 17d6 pool spent eight dice per bonus action at 18 metres, maximised inside the Hearth, plus a free short rest at 14.

action-economy.split: Druid 17 (Circle of the Shepherd) / Ranger 3 (Beast Master)
action-economy.why: Every totem is an aura buffing the partner, and Beast Master's companion joins Conjure Animals and the familiar on the field.

druid/Circle of the Shepherd.uncertain: Mighty Summoner's level here, and Guardian Spirit and Faithful Summons entirely, are unverified in the class file.

action-economy.why: The spirit is a permanent body that casts your spells from its own position, a second AoE origin a duo cannot otherwise generate.

druid/Circle of Wildfire.uncertain: Exact levels for Cauterizing Flames and Blazing Revival are unverified, and Blazing Revival fires only on the spirit's turn.

lockdown.why: A gear-free scaling elemental engine capped at Wisdom-modifier stacks; the level 14 shared immunity helps, but the numbers stay small.

druid/Circle of Wrath.uncertain: The author's documentation stops at level 14, so 15-20 is unverified despite the pack advertising full level-20 support.

short-rest.split: Mesmerist 17 (Aspect of the Trickster) / Bard 3 (College of Lore)
short-rest.why: Tricks fire as free actions: Mesmeric Mirror auto-misses an attack on the partner, Gift of Will adds Charisma plus half level to their Wisdom saves.

mesmerist/Aspect of the Trickster — the.uncertain: Mesmerist's maximum spell level (probably 5th) and its multiclass proficiency node are both undocumented by the mod.

lockdown.split: Mesmerist 17 (Aspect of the Eyebiter) / Sorcerer 3 (Draconic Bloodline)
lockdown.why: Hypnotic Stare is an at-will, concentration-free save penalty carrying Bold Stare riders, and Psychic Inception at 7 defeats mind-immune enemies.

mesmerist/Aspect of the Eyebiter — the d.uncertain: Same undocumented spell cap and multiclass node; the Resistance boon's all-damage tier at 10 was not verified against the pak.

reaction.split: Mesmerist 14 (Aspect of the Daredevil) / Rogue 3 (Swashbuckler) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
reaction.why: Superior Defense adds Charisma to unarmoured AC, and Deeds grants a third reaction at 9 for Riposte and Uncanny Dodge.

mesmerist/Aspect of the Daredevil — the.uncertain: Panache refills only on crits or piercing kills, otherwise long rest, so Extra Attack and the level 9 gate can lapse mid-day.

front-line.why: Frenzy's bonus-action attack plus Action Surge and a third bonus action; Retaliation at 14 spends Lone Wolf's spare reaction.

front-line.split: Barbarian 17 (Path of the Giant) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
front-line.why: Listo's throw fixes stack Reckless Attack, Brutal Critical and a doubled Rage throw bonus at 16; Huge reach arrives at 14.

front-line.split: Barbarian 17 (Path of Wild Magic) / Ranger 3 (Beast Master)
front-line.why: Magic Awareness adds proficiency to spell saves, Bolstering Magic hands the partner a slot each rest, and the companion is a third body.

durability.why: Bear Heart resistance under Lone Wolf's halving, Bestial Attunement's real taunt at 14, and Friar temp HP for both characters each turn.

reaction.split: Barbarian 14 (Path of the Ancestral Guardian) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master) / Rogue 3 (Thief)
reaction.why: Spirit Shield spends the spare reaction to cut 3d6 off the partner, and Ancestral Protectors redirects fire onto the durable body.

front-line.why: Thief's extra bonus action is the only way to afford the 1d4 spike attack, and medium metal armour costs Unarmoured Defence.

front-line.split: Barbarian 17 (Path of the Beast) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
front-line.why: Claws add an attack per Attack action and Call the Hunt gives the partner +1d6 per turn for the whole Rage.

durability.why: Resolute Stance imposes disadvantage on every attack against you on demand, and Hurricane Strike hands the partner a free reaction attack.

durability.split: Barbarian 17 (Path of the Storm Herald) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
durability.why: Tundra feeds the partner temp HP every turn off no rest resource, and Shielding Storm shares your resistance from level 10.

front-line.split: Barbarian 17 (Path of the Zealot) / Bloodhunter 3 (Order of the Ghostslayer)
front-line.why: Divine Fury scales with Barbarian level and stacks with Crimson Rite; Fanatical Focus rerolls a failed save every Rage, not every rest.

reaction.why: Advantage on spell saves plus a Constitution-check counterspell and a crit downgrade, both reactions, against Listo's unusually caster-dense enemies.

barbarian/Path of the Lightning Vessel.uncertain: Listo ships CD's nerf patch inside the Wabbajack; it is not in the manifest, so every Galvanic Heart number here is the unmodified mod's and is too high.

front-line.split: Barbarian 17 (Path of the Lightning Vessel) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
front-line.why: Bonus-action congestion until 10, where the free Lightning Step unblocks it; the lightning scales off Constitution, already co-primary here.

durability.split: Barbarian 17 (Path of the Revenant) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
durability.why: Heavy armour, physical resistance and flat DR 2 under Lone Wolf's halving, but nothing can heal you, which vetoes a healer partner.

action-economy.why: Fast Hands plus Lone Wolf is a third bonus action, Dread Ambusher adds initiative and a first-round attack, and Sneak Attack never rests.

front-line.why: Alacrity, Action Surge and Lone Wolf give four opening Actions against creatures that have not acted; it contributes least in long fights.

skills.why: Both halves run on Intelligence: Bladesong buys AC and concentration in light armour, and transcription turns Listo's scroll drops into a library.

front-line.why: Rakish Audacity needs no flanking body, which a duo lacks; the empty 13-20 table is why this one leaves at eleven.
Insightful Fighting is a repeatable, no-ally Sneak Attack enabler, and Steady Eye with Expertise covers Perception and Investigation for the campaign.

action-economy.why: Bonus-action Help lifts the partner off the floor without spending an Action, and Lore Expertise plus Jack of All Trades covers every gate.

front-line.why: Wails from the Grave splits Sneak Attack across two targets, and Whispers of the Dead grants all skills of one ability per short rest.
Ambush Master and Dread Ambusher stack on Listo's d10 initiative, and the first-round mark grants the partner advantage as well.

rogue/Soulknife.uncertain: The mod page never states the number, size or recovery rate of Psionic Energy Dice, so the resource that powers the whole subclass is unpriced.

front-line.why: Weapon, accuracy fix, mobility and invisibility all come from one pool, but Psychic is commonly resisted under Absolute Wrath.

reaction.why: Auspicious Parry and Spell Siphon both spend reactions Lone Wolf doubled, and Artificer infusions feed the same Intelligence the Seeker already needs.

action-economy.split: Ranger 17 (Beast Master) / Druid 3 (Circle of the Land)
action-economy.why: Panther scales off your proficiency bonus and Helps as a bonus action, Wild Companion adds a familiar, and both halves run on Wisdom.

front-line.why: Dread Ambusher and Assassin's Alacrity delete one enemy before it acts, and Iron Mind at 7 patches the Ranger's missing Wisdom save.
Volley at 11 is the class's only real AoE, and Action Surge fires it twice in the round that has to clear adds.

lockdown.why: Moths blind once per round off your own attack at no concentration cost, and the free reposition answers being focused with no third body.

action-economy.why: Infused Strikes adds 1d6 to the partner's attacks too, and Reflexive Resistance is a second life-saving reaction Lone Wolf makes affordable.

skills.why: Wisdom added to every Charisma check plus Lore's Expertise and three proficiencies makes one character the face with no Charisma investment.

front-line.why: Planar Warrior converts all of the hit to Force, deleting Absolute Wrath's resistances; Thief's bonus action pays for it beside Hunter's Mark.

front-line.split: Ranger 17 (Monster Slayer) / Bloodhunter 3 (Order of the Ghostslayer)
front-line.why: Slayer's Prey costs no concentration, so it stacks with Hunter's Mark and Crimson Rite; Magic-User's Nemesis is a free counterspell.

durability.why: Guardian Aura heals a hurt partner every turn for no action and no camp supplies; the five-foot form speed means a bow, not a charge.

lockdown.why: Divine Smite is Radiant, so every smite triggers Glaring Frost's blind, and Snowborn Anthelion at 15 spreads that save to everything nearby.

front-line.split: Ranger 17 (Conclave of the Dawnstriders) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
front-line.why: Divine Flurry at 11 is five extra attacks at a reduced crit threshold and Action Surge buys a second Valkyrie; Faded is the cost.

action-economy.why: Red Banner hands the partner a reaction attack, banners count as attacks after 5, and level 6 moves the charges to short rest.

front-line.why: Stripping resistances, blocking healing and treating the target as sunlit makes the partner's damage type stop mattering; Bird Cage punishes disengaging.

durability.why: Flat damage reduction is worth double under Lone Wolf's halving, physical resistance lands at 13, and Competitive Streak refunds dice off partner crits.

front-line.why: Shifting Court swaps the armoured body into the pack and pulls the partner out, and Thief's bonus action pays for it every turn.

short-rest.why: Scholar's Armament makes Charisma the attack stat, so Paragon Of Legend's +4 past the 20 cap lands entirely on the one stat.

front-line.why: Falling Rain is a free-action attack on every Willpower Die spent, and Beyond All Limits at 18 refills the pool each turn.

inquisitor/Tactics Inquisition.why: The subclass lands at level 3, where the shipped install has a dangling subclass GUID; the mod needs updating to 2.2.1.

inquisitor/Vengeance Inquisition.why: Unreachable: Inquisitor is unusable past level 2 on the shipped install because of the dangling level-3 subclass GUID; needs the mod updated to 2.2.1.

inquisitor/Zeal Inquisition.why: Every feature sits at Inquisitor 3 or later, and the shipped install breaks at level 3 on a dangling GUID; needs updating to 2.2.1.
